Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €18.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We highly appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we gladly accept to support a more competitive price.
However, switching to DAP delivery would significantly increase costs, so we have maintained EXW terms to offer you the best possible rate.
Our colleagues will provide the requested cost breakdown separately.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.80 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Please note that your offer is far below any calculation we can make. 

Our offer stands at a price of €18.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. We would like to add that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest, which is priced in. Furthermore, a shorter Lieferzeit means overtime, and that is priced in as well. Finally, a different delivery term moves the freight between us, which is also priced in. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to working together and building a successful partnership.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
